pricing_rules_valid_range.name: pricing_rules_valid_range
pricing_rules_valid_range.value: "pricing_rules"."valid_from" is null or "pricing_rules"."valid_to" is null or "pricing_rules"."valid_to" > "pricing_rules"."valid_from"

pricing_rules_kind_fields.name: pricing_rules_kind_fields
pricing_rules_kind_fields.value:
case "pricing_rules"."kind"
        when 'DAILY_RATE' then "pricing_rules"."category_id" is not null and "pricing_rules"."amount_fils" is not null
        when 'VAT' then "pricing_rules"."rate_bps" is not null
        else "pricing_rules"."amount_fils" is not null end

reservations_money_nonneg.name: reservations_money_nonneg
reservations_money_nonneg.value:
"reservations"."daily_rate_fils" >= 0 and "reservations"."base_fils" >= 0 and "reservations"."extras_fils" >= 0 and "reservations"."one_way_fee_fils" >= 0
        and "reservations"."subtotal_fils" >= 0 and "reservations"."vat_fils" >= 0 and "reservations"."total_fils" >= 0 and "reservations"."deposit_fils" >= 0
